    • enclosingMethodParamCBOR

      public com.upokecenter.cbor.CBORObject enclosingMethodParamCBOR(com.upokecenter.cbor.CBORObject yangProvenance, byte[] signature, String moduleName, String leafName)
      Inserts a COSE signature into a YANG CBOR document using the "moduleName:leafName" format as defined by the YANG augment.
      Specified by:
      enclosingMethodParamCBOR in interface CBOREnclosingMethodsInterface
      Parameters:
      yangProvenance - the original YANG document encoded as a CBORObject. Must be of type CBORType.Map.
      signature - the COSE_Sign1 signature as raw bytes. This will be inserted as a CBOR ByteString.
      moduleName - the YANG module name defining the augment.
      leafName - the leaf name where the signature must be stored.
      Returns:
      a new CBORObject containing the inserted signature field.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the CBOR structure does not match the expected YANG top-level map structure.

    • enclosingMethodYANGCBOR

      public com.upokecenter.cbor.CBORObject enclosingMethodYANGCBOR(com.upokecenter.cbor.CBORObject yangProvenance, byte[] signature, File yangModule) throws IOException
      Inserts a COSE signature into a YANG CBOR document by automatically extracting the module name and signature leaf metadata from a YANG module file.
      Specified by:
      enclosingMethodYANGCBOR in interface CBOREnclosingMethodsInterface
      Parameters:
      yangProvenance - the original YANG CBOR document.
      signature - the COSE_Sign1 signature as raw bytes.
      yangModule - the YANG module file used to extract metadata (module name and leaf definition).
      Returns:
      a CBORObject containing the signature inserted according to the YANG module definition.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the YANG module file cannot be read or parsed.
      IllegalArgumentException - if the CBOR structure does not match the expected YANG encoding.
